decision_conditions:
We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree? 
'Replacement of front entrance canopy with a porch'

We require Existing/Proposed Side Elevations and Floor Plans.
description:
As per our structural engineer’s advice, due to ageing of the property with end fixing of tie road in metal causing expansion at the connection point to existing masonry wall, diagonal cracks at 1st floor level are visible. 

Additionally, when inspecting from inside of the property at the 1st floor level, it was determined the front wall has been misaligned and moved by approximately 15mm to 20mm causing impact to the overall
stability of the existing front façade.

It is therefore concluded that the existing suspended front entrance canopy needs to be immediately removed and replaced
with a new independent structural framing consisting of steel beam and post design.
